behavior: A Dialog, an Alert Dialog or a Drawer with `modal` set to `true` sets `inert` on the nodes outside the popup. Tab cannot reach those nodes, and a press cannot reach an element that is drawn above the backdrop. Live regions, scripts, nested portal nodes and focus guards do not get `inert`, as in Base UI. `modal="trap-focus"` and all other popups keep the `aria-hidden` marks of Base UI.
